name: broadcast-and-blackout-pwas
description: This repository contains the core logic, UI engine, and data files for independent NHL blackout guides. The architecture is designed to support deploying multiple independent single-page Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) from a single shared codebase.

scripts.e2e:install: npm install --save-dev @playwright/test && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.test:all: bash tests/check_privacy.sh && node tests/data_audit.test.js && node scripts/audit_data.js && node scripts/matrix_test.js && node scripts/qa_validator.js && npx playwright test tests/ui.spec.js tests/game_flow.spec.js tests/blackout-engine.spec.js --workers=2
